item.tib: rtsa gsum rab 'byams 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin phyi nang gsang gsum gyi phyag bzhes 'dod 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces smon tshig dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes 'dod 'byung nor phreng zhes bya ba 'di yang rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen la dad mos snying nas mi 'bral zhing / bka' lung 'di lta bu la dad pa gting nas skyes pa'i ldong rigs sprang btsun pa shes rab phun tshogs bdag gis/ sgo gsum gcig tu dril nas bla ma dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro la gsol ba yengs med du btab nas/ drin can bla ma'i gsung bzhin rnga chen zhes pa chu khyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la spel ba'o//
